Full summary: Task 4 (/api/graph/summary + /api/graph/entities endpoints) implemented via subagent, TDD green (22/22 endpoint tests, suite 1136 pass, tsc clean), legacy /api/graph regression test added. Review running; commit follows approval.
Decisions: Accepted implementer judgment: /api/graph/entities sort is a fixed degree-desc/name-asc default and the sort query param is ignored rather than switchable — the plan's frontend (graph drill list) only ever sorts by degree; YAGNI. Revisit only if Phase 4 needs a sort toggle.
Findings: Graph endpoint semantics pinned: degree increments both endpoints per relation; group_edges aggregate by unordered type pair and skip relations with missing endpoint entities (still counted in relation_count); hubs top-20 by degree with name-asc ties.
